player_requirements: PvE roguelite with AI-controlled teams, recruitment and deployment between increasingly difficult encounters
Preserve original creature stats by default; curate roster and permit logical native cross-species evolution
Improve battlefield UI and author an actual textured arena using available original assets
Localize all eventual player-facing mode content in English, Russian and German

data_census.scope: Rows include named/scripted and repeated variants. Map checks read headers and atlas references, not rendered layouts. Separate editions require separate balance.

native_damage_note: damage_max in the database is an added random range; final maximum equals damage_min + damage_max.

paired_evolution_probe.scope: Native melee stats/AI; headless flat field; paired sides and group insertion order. No projectiles, mixed teams, economy or full runs.

paired_probe_execution.warning: Godot reported the configured separate rendering thread as experimental; this was a headless correctness probe, not a render benchmark.
limitations: 12 paired seeds per case; 24 fights are not 24 independent seed samples.
Side swaps also reverse group insertion order, but do not eliminate every AI/RNG/formation dependency.
Only melee matchups, flat ground, presentation disabled and 55 ms manual world ticks.
No projectiles, spells, mixed armies, shop, economy, campaign modifiers, authored terrain or complete PvE runs.
Output-versus-input victory does not determine fair price or the value of freed deployment slots.

earlier_boar_probe.scope: 144 preliminary native-stat melee fights. Higher unit always spawned first; sides alternated with different seeds, not paired. Do not pool with the later fixture as one controlled experiment.

shop_model.model: Binomial offer availability for a single preselected creature; not run win rate
assumptions: 5 independent uniform shop offers per round, with replacement
No starting copy, rerolls, locks, costs, rarity weights, purchases or bench limits
2-copy same-rank merging needs 2 base copies for rank II and 4 for rank III
3-copy same-rank merging needs 3 base copies for rank II and 9 for rank III
shop_model.formula: P(X >= k) = sum(comb(n,i) * p**i * (1-p)**(n-i), i=k..n), with n=5*rounds and p=1/pool_size

design_starting_point.status: Proposed tuning seed. No economy, wave or full-run balance validated yet.
